definitions.ce_ggn: Affine weight block of generalized Gauss-Newton for mean CE; omits cross-layer blocks and true-Hessian model-second-derivative terms.
definitions.jacobian_gram: Mean per-example J_logits.T @ J_logits affine weight block, summed over output classes, not divided by number of classes.
definitions.empirical_fisher: Mean outer product of observed-label per-example CE gradients; not generally equal to the Hessian or CE-GGN.
definitions.kfac: Product of separately averaged activation and backprop factors; cross-factor dependence is discarded.
definitions.rank: effective_rank = trace/top eigenvalue; stable_rank = Frobenius norm squared/top eigenvalue squared.
definitions.zero_denominators: Undefined ratios are null; exact zeros are not represented as an informative finite ratio.
definitions.sampling: Exact observed-label Fisher on the fixed probe. Sampled GGN/Jacobian use independent per-example Rademacher probes averaged over samples; ratios/ranks of sampled matrices are not unbiased estimates of exact ratios/ranks.
definitions.scope: Dense eval-mode probe; no masked training gradients and no full parameter-square matrix.
